stvc_no_bed_between.accept_text: Walk it. Not the first mile - down to the ford where the Veilfall crosses the road, which is where the raptors have been working, because that is the one place on the road a person has to slow down. If you can manage ten, and look at the stones in the ford while you are standing in it. If anyone went into that water I want to know before their mother does.

stvc_fenn_weather.accept_text: There is a band of moss along the lip where the spray reaches and nowhere else - Good handfuls would do me the season. Mind the leechswarms in the slack water under the pool. Those, and the shallows are yours. And while you are gone, think about this for me: where you're from, does the rain come in a season, or does it come all year? Everything I know about a plant assumes a wet month and a dry month. If it rains all year where you came from then half of what I know is local, and I would very much like to find out which half.

stvc_fenn_lit_fall.accept_text: The panthers work the lip at dusk, which is the honest reason I have never walked round to look - Them between my rack and the notch, most evenings, and I am a man with a trowel. Go round to the mouth. That is all. Stand at it and come back and tell me whether there is a door there, because I have spent two years deciding there was not one.

stvc_zuljana_names.turn_in_text: Stones, four names, and the fourth one is not a name for the cave at all. It is a name for the water. And it is the same word the Gurbashi use for the sand on their arena floor - the exact same word, same two sounds, and one lot means a river and the other lot means a killing-ground. I have known both of those words my whole life and never once put them next to each other. Go and ask the gatehouse what they think they are saying.
stvc_zuljana_names.accept_text: Zul'Dakai. That is the one you may have, and it means the stone the water argues with - you can carry that word north and the camp can put it on a map and be pleased with itself. Each terrace has a name stone set into its lip. Bring me them. The mistcallers will not let you stand on a terrace long enough to read one, so you will have to go through them first, and I am not going to pretend to you that I like asking for that.

stvc_zuljana_font.accept_text: Cords and the chamber they are read in. Nothing else - leave the shrine alone, it is not ours and it is not yours. The spraywater will come at you in the Font because the Font is what they are made of; them will clear you a quarter of an hour to work in. Read nothing. Carry it. I will do the reading.

stvc_garza_report.accept_text: The rockthrowers pick up anything that catches the light and they put it on the midden behind the camp, and I have been looking at that midden through nothing at all for nine weeks. All of them, and bring me things off the pile. Not the bones. The made things. If the glass is in there it is in there with a brass collar and my number stamped on the collar, and if it is not in there then I am going to have to write a tenth report that says something different from the other nine.

stvc_ulua_netsetter.turn_in_text:
All of them, and you reset them right, which I did not expect.

Something I will ask you and then we will not discuss it again. Where you're from - is there standing water? Brackish, slow, the kind that does not go anywhere?

And does anyone fish it.

I am not making conversation. I would like to know whether this is a trade that exists in more than one place, in case it stops existing in this one.

stvc_crate_nail.accept_text: There is only one man in this jungle who would recognise a run number on sight, and he is in Booty Bay behind a desk, and he will be unbearable about being asked. Go through the brutes on the way down off the shelf - Them hold the notch, and they are the ones with the nailed timber in their camp, which is the part you want to be sure of before you say any of this out loud to a clerk.

stvc_drum_callers.turn_in_text: Same hand on all of them. Same hand as the drovers' book, which means the stock fraud and the slow count are one scheme with two ends, and I have been pricing them as two different kinds of bad luck for a season. I am not taking this to the house. The house takes a cut of both ends. I am going to go on pricing it, now that I know which way it leans. That is not honest and I am not going to pretend it is. It is just what a woman does with information she paid for.
stvc_drum_callers.accept_text: The callers, out on the drum line east of the gate apron, and do it where the rim can see which of them you are doing it to. Then the stock tallies, and you will have to go back to the crates for those because that is where the paper comes from. Signed-in weight is as good as coin down here and better than coin, because coin has to be counted by somebody and a tally only has to be waved. If I am wrong about this I have just had nine musicians killed over a rounding error, so bring the paper.

stvc_limeback_lamps.accept_text: The limebacks have come up off the lowest terrace now that there is nobody keeping them down there. Before they find the ramp. They are not the shrinekeepers and they will not stop at the lip. More handfuls of the spray moss while you are on the band - I am not going to pretend I have stopped selling it. And go down to the lowest terrace. The oil is in a jar under the bracket, if nobody has knocked it over. I know where the jar is because he told me, on the Wednesday, when I went in with a gift and came out without saying a word.

stvc_notch_tithe.turn_in_text: Stamped, one of them twice, and a drover line that is going to be thin for a week. Good. Here is the report, and you are in it, and you are in it as the unnamed party, and I have signed under it that the items came to me in the condition described. That sentence is me staking my own post on your word. It is the largest thing I have got and it is a line of small handwriting on the third page. Eleven weeks ago I would not have written it. Sitting on one road teaches you who actually comes up it.
stvc_notch_tithe.accept_text: More made things off the midden - the stamped ones, not the bones, same as last time. And the drovers at the crate line, because the trade has an end down there and I would like the end down there to be short of hands when somebody finally reads my paper. I will put it plainly, because you will work it out on the walk and I would rather you heard it from me. I cannot put you in the report as the witness. A tribunal wants a name with a village behind it and a commander who will stand up for it, and you have the first of those. You are going to be the unnamed party who recovered the items. That is not what I think of you. It is what the form has room for.

stvc_tout_entry.accept_text: The drovers are running undersized stock into the crates and signing it in at weight. Thin card, thin crowd, thin money, and I am the one holding paper on a thin afternoon. The drovers and their tallies. And before you ask why I bet on somebody I have never watched fight - that is the entire reason. Nobody down here has a form line on you. The rim prices a stranger generously and a known quantity honestly, and I have never once made a living off honest.

stvc_tout_staked.accept_text: Take the chit up the apron to the broker and put it in his hand. Not on the table. In the hand, and stand there while he reads it. The gate crew will try to stop you getting that far, because that is the job they are paid for and they will do it without any feeling about it. Do not take it personally and do not take it slowly.

stvc_scrip_drums.accept_text: Right, so you go up the road and you count them. I want how many drums, how wide across the top, and what they are made of, and do not just say gorilla because I know it is gorilla, I want it written down by somebody who was there. The big apes, the ones they call drumhides - that is a clue, that is practically the answer - and bits of hide so I can feel it. And stand on the flat bit in front of the gate so you can tell me how many people fit.

stvc_north_leg.accept_text: The limewings, and take them in the cave where they sleep, not on the perch where they are awake and I have beasts on the ground. Then stand on the perch itself on the basin lip, and feel the air coming off that water, and understand why I will not put a wyvern down there. Last thing. This wrap goes up the line, and the line is me as far as the valley and Ghulrak after that. Only I am not flying the basin and Ghulrak is not coming south for one bundle, so the honest answer is that you are the middle of the line this week. Hand it to him yourself.

stvc_reed_verdict.accept_text: This is a gauge board. Oak, numbered, cut by my father and used for a weir that silted up before you were born. Set it in the lip above your waterfall where the stone is sound, and set it where a short person can read it, because the next one who reads it will not be you. The spraywater elementals will come up out of the Font while you are working, because they are made of exactly the water you are trying to measure. That is a sentence I have had to say out loud to hear how it sounds.

stvc_scrip_second.accept_text: Right. I've got questions and I've written them on my hand, so don't go anywhere. And I need the marsh crocs done. Not for the hide - for how big the biggest one is. If the biggest croc in that marsh isn't as wide across the belly as a drum is across the top, then it can't be croc, can it, and then I'm right and Hobb's wrong and you're wrong too but mostly Hobb. That's called a test. Bexx told me about tests. He said most people don't do one because they'd rather be right.

stvc_cord_sealed.accept_text: More cords off the Font before I seal the bundle. Read this morning, not last month, so nobody can tell me afterward that my water is a season stale. Then go up to the lamp gallery above the plunge and stand on the terrace behind the brackets. There is a waterline on that stone, and there is a second one above it, and the gap between them is the only part of this you will be asked about by somebody who matters. Look at it with your own eyes. I am not sending an account of a thing you have not seen.
